usedBy.name: React Native
usedBy.note: Uses the C++ Yoga engine, not the Rust bindings.

features.name: Horizontal and vertical stacks
features.note: Row and column flows. This does not imply CSS flexbox conformance.

features.name: CSS flexbox
features.note: Morphorm uses stretch units. Torin uses its own flex content and sizing model. Yoga has some defaults that differ from browsers. ui_layout implements an experimental flexbox-inspired model, not full CSS compatibility.

features.name: CSS grid
features.note: Morphorm exposes grid tracks and spans, not the complete CSS grid model. Torin and Yoga do not support CSS grid. The pinned ui_layout Git revision implements an experimental grid subset.

features.name: Wrapping flow
features.note: Native flow wrapping, with different sizing semantics between libraries. ui_layout wrapping is available in the pinned Git revision.

features.name: Fixed and percentage sizes
features.note: Explicit sizes and sizes relative to the containing area.

features.name: Content-based sizing
features.note: Size a container from its contents.

features.name: Padding and gaps
features.note: Inner spacing and spacing between children.

features.name: In-flow margins
features.note: Morphorm's edge spacing applies to absolute nodes, not in-flow margins. Its adapter skips margin templates.

features.name: Aspect ratio property
features.note: Torin and ui_layout adapters skip ratio templates because the benchmarked versions have no aspect-ratio style property. ui_layout can apply ratios through custom-object sizing, which is not the same as a general node style property.

features.name: Custom content measurement
features.note: Taffy has a measurement callback, Morphorm has Node::content_size, Torin has LayoutMeasurer, Yoga has a measure function, and ui_layout has CustomLayouter. These hooks are not built-in text shaping or text measurement engines.

features.name: CSS block layout
features.note: Taffy and ui_layout implement CSS-style block formatting. Morphorm and Torin stacks are not CSS block layout. Yoga is a flexbox engine without CSS block layout.

features.name: Pixel-grid rounding
features.note: Taffy and Yoga round layout output to a pixel grid. Morphorm rounds some percentage sizes and stretch allocations, but does not guarantee pixel-aligned output for all coordinates. Torin has scaling helpers but no built-in output-snapping pass. ui_layout's round() length expression does not round all layout output.
